tools.name: get_account
tools.description:
Show the authenticated account

Returns the account the presented token belongs to, so it also serves as a
credential check.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description:
List devices

Lists the account's tracking devices, filterable by name, serial, status and model. Use it to find a
device id; `include=last_position` adds where each device is now. Each device's page in the GPX app is
https://app.gpx.co/trackers/{id}.

name.description: Partial match on the device name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

serial.description: Exact match. A serial is looked up, not searched. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

model.description: A device model. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

include.description: Include telemetry and/or last_position. Comma-separate values. Omitted by default because both are cross-store reads.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

tools.name: get_device
tools.description:
Show a device

Returns one device with its status, sharing link and container type. `include=last_position` adds
where it is now, and `include=telemetry` its battery, speed and whether it is moving. The device's page
in the GPX app is https://app.gpx.co/trackers/{id}.

include.description: Include telemetry and/or last_position. Comma-separate values. Omitted by default because both are cross-store reads.

tools.name: list_device_positions
tools.description:
List a device's positions

Returns the positions a device recorded within a time window, 24 hours by default. Use it for where
a device has been; for where it is now, use `get_device` with `include=last_position`.

location_after.description: Start of the window on the time the device recorded the fix. Defaults to 24 hours before location_before. Must be a valid date.

location_before.description: End of the window on the time the device recorded the fix. Defaults to now. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to location_after.

sort.description: Sort on location_at, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

tools.name: list_device_events
tools.description:
List a device's events

Returns one device's events (geofence enters and exits, alarms, shipment events) within a time
window: the `list_events` feed, scoped to one device.

event_after.description: Start of the window on event_at. Defaults to 24 hours before event_before when both are omitted, or 30 days before event_before when only event_before is set. Must be a valid date.

event_before.description: End of the window on event_at. Defaults to now when omitted, or 30 days after event_after when only event_after is set. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to event_after.

sort.description: Sort on event_at. Prefix with - for descending. Defaults to -event_at.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

geofence_id.description: Restrict to events for one geofence. Must be at least 1.

shipment_id.description: Restrict to events for one shipment. Must be at least 1.

event_type.description: Event type (e.g. geofence-exit, alarm-sos, shipment-late). Repeatable. Must not be greater than 128 characters.

tools.name: list_geofences
tools.description:
List geofences

Lists the account's geofences, the named places devices enter and leave. Filterable by place type
and ownership type, each multi-value. Each geofence's page in the GPX app is
https://app.gpx.co/geofences/{id}.

place_type.description: A place type slug, standard or one of the account's own. A standard slug also matches its custom types. Up to 100 values.

search.description: Partial match on the geofence name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

tools.name: get_geofence
tools.description:
Show a geofence

Returns one geofence with its geometry, place type, ownership type and alerting settings. The geofence's
page in the GPX app is https://app.gpx.co/geofences/{id}.

tools.name: list_shipments
tools.description:
List shipments

Lists the account's shipments, filterable by status, carrier, origin or destination geofence, and
pickup or delivery dates. Use `search` to find one by name. Each shipment's page in the GPX app is
https://app.gpx.co/shipments/{id}.

carrier.description: Exact carrier name. Comma-separate for several.

destination_geofence_id.description: Only shipments arriving at this geofence.

pickup_after.description: Earliest pickup — actual once departed, otherwise scheduled. Must be a valid date.

pickup_before.description: Latest pickup — actual once departed, otherwise scheduled. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to pickup_after.

delivery_after.description: Earliest delivery — actual once delivered, otherwise scheduled. Must be a valid date.

delivery_before.description: Latest delivery — actual once delivered, otherwise scheduled. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to delivery_after.

search.description: Partial match on the shipment name or carrier. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

tools.name: get_shipment
tools.description:
Show a shipment

Returns one shipment with its status, devices and stops. The shipment's page in the GPX app is
https://app.gpx.co/shipments/{id}.

tools.name: list_shipment_stops
tools.description:
List stops for a shipment

Returns a shipment's itinerary in order. `stop_type` marks each stop as the origin, the destination
or a stop in between.

tools.name: list_shipment_routes
tools.description:
List route segments for a shipment

Returns a shipment's route segments: the leg between two of its stops, the corridor width around it
and the routes it may take.

annotations.title: List route segments for a shipment

tools.name: get_shipment_route
tools.description:
Show a route segment

Returns one route segment of a shipment.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description:
List users

Every row carries the account-scoped permission structure. permissions.device_ids
and permissions.group_ids are the explicit direct grants only, not the resolved
fleet the user can see.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description:
Show a user

Returns one teammate with their role and their direct device and group grants.

tools.name: list_container_types
tools.description:
List container types

Lists the account's container types, the labels for the returnable containers its devices travel
in. Only on accounts with returnable containers; elsewhere every container type call is a 404.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending. Defaults to name.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

tools.name: get_container_type
tools.description:
Show a container type

Returns one container type.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description:
List account events

Returns the account's event feed across every device (geofence enters and exits, alarms, shipment
events) within a time window, 24 hours by default. Filter by device, geofence, shipment or event
type; a geofence's enter and exit history is this feed filtered by `geofence_id`.

event_after.description: Start of the window on event_at. Defaults to 24 hours before event_before when both are omitted, or 30 days before event_before when only event_before is set. Must be a valid date.

event_before.description: End of the window on event_at. Defaults to now when omitted, or 30 days after event_after when only event_after is set. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to event_after.

sort.description: Sort on event_at. Prefix with - for descending. Defaults to -event_at.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

device_id.description: Restrict to one device. Must be at least 1.

geofence_id.description: Restrict to events for one geofence. Must be at least 1.

shipment_id.description: Restrict to events for one shipment. Must be at least 1.

event_type.description: Event type (e.g. geofence-exit, alarm-sos, shipment-late). Repeatable. Must not be greater than 128 characters.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description:
List groups

Lists the account's device groups. A group's devices are listed with `list_group_members`. Each group's
page in the GPX app is https://app.gpx.co/groups/{id}.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

tools.name: get_group
tools.description:
Show a group

Returns one device group. Its devices are listed with `list_group_members`. The group's page in the GPX
app is https://app.gpx.co/groups/{id}.

tools.name: list_group_members
tools.description:
List a group's members

Phase 1 groups are device-only, so every member carries type "device".

per_page.description: Members per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

tools.name: list_place_types
tools.description:
List place types

The standard types first, then the account's custom types, each group by name.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

tools.name: get_place_type
tools.description:
Show a place type

Returns one place type, standard or custom.

placeTypeSlug.description: A place type slug, from `list_place_types`. Standard types can be read but not changed or deleted.
